status_at_creation: frozen exploratory specification; phase model not yet implemented or fitted
controls: reuse original B0, B_SET and B1 predictions/parameters for exactly the same sample IDs; verify frozen artifact hashes; do not refit B1
B_PHASE: for phase_state in pq_first/pq_second/pq_sustained_observed, predict AC(t)+beta_phase*(Set(t)-AC(t)); otherwise use original B_SET fallback, retain every sample
fit: three separate coefficients, fit-partition origins in each of the three phase groups only; beta_raw=sum(x*d)/sum(x*x), x=Set(t)-AC(t), d=AC(t+1)-AC(t); beta=min(1,max(0,beta_raw)); no intercept or other parameters
constraint_basis: same declared blend as original B1, not identified hardware time constants; report unconstrained values and boundary hits
unidentifiable_group: if no fit samples or denominator<=0/nonfinite, label coefficient unavailable and use B_SET for that group in all partitions; report fallback coverage, never invent a coefficient or drop the group
unknown_phase_fallback: B_SET (current setpoint for current PQ, persistence otherwise); no unknown age converted to 0; sustained lower bound>=2 may use sustained coefficient while censoring flag remains
validation_role: fixed exploratory diagnostic and implementation checks, no search over phase cutoffs, horizons, lags, losses or models
evaluation_role: previously used April evaluation supports retrospective comparison only; never call it independent confirmation of the phase design
main_metric: unchanged: current-PQ evaluation daily MAE in kW, equal-weighted across its six origin dates; compare each control and per-date paired differences
additional_metrics: each known/unknown/censored phase counts and errors
pooled PQ MAE and signed bias
future-change diagnostics retained out of predictors
largest residuals, failures and fallback samples
failures: retain every sample and failure record; no error- or future-mode-based exclusion, report coverage
reproducibility: repeat fixed source/features/protocol; coefficients and predictions atol=1e-10, metrics atol=1e-9 kW; independent raw-prefix verification before claiming closure
freeze: phase rules and fitting formula frozen before new fitting; design follows post-hoc April residual findings, explicitly exploratory
independent_confirmation: requires a time period/source not used for phase design, plus purpose-specific raw admission; unavailable at this freeze
interpretation: phase model can fail to improve; no mandatory retention, complexity advantage, physical delay/capacity or 90% claim
